grading: WSL KiCad 10.0.7 for every row, one job at a time, serial. canary-plugin45: canary's grade.sh steps (ses_import.py, kicad-cli pcb drc --schematic-parity --refill-zones, via_in_pad.py, inner_tracks.py) against canary b1994423 through Q13's path shim. Other rows: tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh with the arm command as the engine (strip tracks and vias, export, route, import, DRC of the unrouted and routed boards under the original rules), plus canary's via_in_pad.py and inner_tracks.py on the routed board and freerouting-dev power-traces on the session. Every route under timeout -k 10 3600; a timeout is a result (the row's arm is ungraded), not a rerun. When two arms' sessions are byte-identical the session is graded once, the baseline's grade. The canary sessions go to target/canary-handoff/2026-10-18-netclass/ for canary's official grade

metric_definitions.netclass_via_clearance_errors: tools/kicad-oracle/oracle_lib.py netclass_clearance over every violation of the routed board's KiCad drc.json: items of type clearance or hole_clearance whose description names a net-class rule ("netclass '<class>' clearance"; KiCad applies the largest rule, so the class clearance is at least the board minimum), with exactly two items, one of them a via, on two different nets. Board-minimum, board-setup, custom-rule and no-net ("( clearance") items do not count. Role guard: the candidate may not be above the baseline on any row (the hard clause of this registration: must not rise)
metric_definitions.netclass_clearance_errors: the same tool: every clearance or hole_clearance item under a net-class rule, any item kinds (reported)
metric_definitions.below_minimum: canary: KiCad track_width errors; KiCad boards: kicad-oracle's copper.below_minimum (copper under the board minimums)
metric_definitions.power_layer_traces: every trace of any net on a power-type layer of the routed DSN (freerouting-dev power-traces, the `all` count); 0 under enhanced's power_layer_traces=none
metric_definitions.drc_real: canary: KiCad error-severity items other than unconnected items and starved thermals; KiCad boards: kicad-oracle's drc_real. Reported, not judged: it holds board-minimum and other clearance types this registration does not judge
metric_definitions.inner_tracks: canary's inner_tracks.py count on the routed board (reported; on canary every inner layer is a plane, which power_layer_traces already judges)
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: KiCad's unconnected items after importing the session (canary: the count canary's grade prints; KiCad boards: kicad-oracle's unconnected_items of the routed board)
metric_definitions.unrouted: the router's final unrouted count (its log)
